spec.name: respondent_profile_enrichment
spec.description: Builds one profile per quiz respondent from the raw quiz tables, then scores each respondent's sustained engagement level and long-term brand affinity concurrently, returning the profiles enriched with both signals.

spec.name: build_respondent_profiles
spec.description: Collapses the flat quiz tables returned by retrieve_tables into one base profile per respondent, nesting each respondent's quizzes, submissions and answers.

spec.name: sustained_engagement_level
spec.description: Scores a respondent's submission history against a ladder of engagement brackets and emits the highest one whose quiz-count, spacing and timeframe conditions all hold.

spec.name: likely_long_term_brand_fan
spec.description: Emits the likely_long_term_brand_fan metatag when any single brand shows a dense, high-scoring run of distinct quiz completions inside one rolling window.

spec.name: merge_profile_signals
spec.description: Copies the current respondent profile and layers on every signal handed to this node by the upstream scoring branches, whatever they happen to be.

RespondentProfileItem.title: RespondentProfileItem
RespondentProfileItem.description:
One respondent profile as iterated by the foreach.

Loose by design: `extra="allow"` lets the full nested profile that
build_respondent_profiles emits (identity, quizzes, submissions, answers)
ride through without every level having to be declared here.
